name: mailchannels
description: Official MailChannels skills for sending transactional email from any app

plugins.name: mailchannels
plugins.description: MailChannels Email API is a transactional email API for any application: password resets, sign-in links, verification codes, receipts, invitations and notifications. Send over REST or SMTP with official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDKs, or keep Laravel Mail, Symfony Mailer or Nodemailer and switch the transport. Every API send returns a request_id that its signed delivery, bounce and complaint webhook events carry, along with an optional campaign_id tag that also filters delivery metrics; managed DKIM, suppressions and one-click unsubscribe are included. Optional sub-accounts give each customer or agent its own credentials and limits when they send through your product. Outbound only; free developer plan for development and testing.
